intro: At Northshire Abbey, Merissa Stilwell welcomes newcomers to Northshire Valley. The young human townsperson offers a cheerful greeting and a helping hand to those training nearby.

p: Merissa Stilwell greets fresh recruits arriving in Northshire Valley from her place at Northshire Abbey. She offers newcomers simple hospitality and practical advice on resting and finding their way. Her surname is shared by craftsmen and homesteaders across the kingdom, including the blacksmith Jordan Stilwell and the Westfall defender Daphne Stilwell. Merissa remains a peaceful local presence amid the kingdom's rising tensions.
